title: Cluster Topology Inspection
objective: Inspect cluster nodes and core components to understand architecture.
objectiveMm: Cluster architecture ကို နားလည်ရန် nodes နှင့် core components များကို စစ်ဆေးလေ့လာခြင်း။
prerequisites: Access to a running Kubernetes cluster
environmentSetup: Use kind/minikube or a kubeadm lab cluster with at least 1 control-plane and 1 worker node.
steps: Run `kubectl cluster-info` and note control plane endpoint.
Run `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and identify roles, versions, internal IPs.
Run `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` and list control plane/system components.
expectedOutput: Node list shows Ready nodes and kube-system shows core components such as kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, coredns, kube-proxy/CNI pods (varies by setup).
troubleshooting: If kubectl cannot connect, verify kubeconfig context and API server endpoint.
If nodes are NotReady, describe nodes and inspect conditions/events.
verificationChecklist: I can identify control plane vs worker nodes.
I can name key control plane components running in the cluster.

title: Control Plane Component Inspection
objective: Locate and inspect control plane component manifests and logs.
objectiveMm: Control plane component manifests/logs များကို ရှာဖွေစစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Use a control-plane node where static pod manifests are under /etc/kubernetes/manifests.
steps: List files in `/etc/kubernetes/manifests` and identify component manifests.
Describe kube-apiserver/scheduler/controller-manager pods in kube-system.
Review recent logs for one control plane component and note key flags/config references.
expectedOutput: Static pod manifests and corresponding pods are visible; logs show component startup/runtime messages.
troubleshooting: Component pod name includes node name in kubeadm clusters.
If logs unavailable, check container runtime logs on the node.
verificationChecklist: I can locate static pod manifests.
I can inspect status/logs of control plane components.

title: Worker Node and kubelet Health Check
objective: Inspect node conditions and kubelet health.
objectiveMm: Node conditions နှင့် kubelet health ကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
prerequisites: SSH/node access for kubelet checks (optional but recommended)
environmentSetup: A cluster with at least one worker node.
steps: Run `kubectl describe node <worker>` and review Conditions, Capacity, Allocatable, and taints.
Check kubelet service status/logs on the node if accessible.
Correlate node conditions with cluster events.
expectedOutput: Node shows Ready condition when healthy; kubelet logs/status provide runtime details.
troubleshooting: NotReady may indicate kubelet, runtime, or network issues.
Check certificate expiration and config file paths if kubelet fails to start.
verificationChecklist: I can interpret node conditions.
I know where to inspect kubelet status/logs.

title: kubeadm Workflow and Node Maintenance
objective: Practice kubeadm lifecycle concepts and safe node maintenance operations.
objectiveMm: kubeadm lifecycle concepts နှင့် node maintenance လုပ်ငန်းစဉ်များကို လေ့ကျင့်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Use a disposable cluster (kind/kubeadm lab) where node drain/uncordon is safe.
steps: Review `kubeadm token create --print-join-command` output (or documented example).
Cordon and drain a worker node while preserving workload availability.
Uncordon the node and verify scheduling resumes.
Review `kubeadm upgrade plan` output in an upgrade-capable environment (or study output format).
expectedOutput: Node becomes SchedulingDisabled after cordon; pods evicted/rescheduled during drain (where possible); node schedulable after uncordon.
troubleshooting: Drain may fail due to PodDisruptionBudgets or standalone pods; use flags carefully in labs.
DaemonSets require --ignore-daemonsets.
verificationChecklist: I can safely drain and uncordon a node.
I understand join/upgrade command purposes.

title: HA Control Plane Concepts Verification
objective: Identify HA control plane components and failure considerations.
objectiveMm: HA control plane components နှင့် failure considerations များကို ဖော်ထုတ်နားလည်ခြင်း။
prerequisites: Conceptual study; HA lab cluster optional
environmentSetup: If available, use a multi-control-plane cluster; otherwise analyze architecture/docs.
steps: List nodes and identify multiple control-plane nodes if present.
Inspect kube-system lease/endpoints objects related to leader election.
Document how API server load balancing and etcd quorum affect availability.
expectedOutput: Understanding of HA topology, leader election resources, and quorum requirements.
troubleshooting: Single-node labs cannot fully demonstrate HA failover; use documentation to supplement.
verificationChecklist: I can explain API load balancer and etcd quorum roles.
I can identify leader election indicators in kube-system.

title: RBAC Role and Binding Practice
objective: Create and verify namespace-scoped RBAC permissions.
objectiveMm: Namespace-scoped RBAC permissions များကို ဖန်တီးပြီး စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Any Kubernetes cluster; create a temporary namespace `rbac-lab`.
steps: Create namespace and a ServiceAccount.
Create a Role allowing get/list/watch on pods.
Bind the Role to the ServiceAccount with a RoleBinding.
Verify allowed/denied actions using `kubectl auth can-i`.

yamlManifests.name: rbac-lab.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: rbac-lab
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: pod-reader-sa
  namespace: rbac-lab
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
  namespace: rbac-lab
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: read-pods-binding
  namespace: rbac-lab
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: pod-reader-sa
  namespace: rbac-lab
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: pod-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

commands: kubectl auth can-i list pods --as=system:serviceaccount:rbac-lab:pod-reader-sa -n rbac-lab
kubectl auth can-i delete pods --as=system:serviceaccount:rbac-lab:pod-reader-sa -n rbac-lab
expectedOutput: ServiceAccount can list/get/watch pods in rbac-lab but cannot delete pods.
troubleshooting: Ensure namespace matches in Role, RoleBinding, and can-i checks.
Use correct subject kind/name for users vs service accounts.
verificationChecklist: Role and RoleBinding created successfully.
Allowed and denied permissions verified.

title: etcd Snapshot Backup and Status Check
objective: Take an etcd snapshot and inspect it (restore steps reviewed in lab notes).
objectiveMm: etcd snapshot backup ယူခြင်းနှင့် စစ်ဆေးခြင်း (restore အဆင့်များကိုလည်း လေ့လာခြင်း)။
prerequisites: Access to etcd endpoint/certs (kubeadm control plane)
environmentSetup: Run on a control-plane node or environment with etcd client certs.
steps: Set ETCDCTL_API=3 and identify endpoint/cert paths.
Run snapshot save to a file in /tmp.
Run snapshot status to verify snapshot integrity metadata.
Review restore command and required manifest/data-dir updates (perform only in disposable lab).
expectedOutput: Snapshot file created and status table displayed.
troubleshooting: Wrong cert/key/endpoint causes connection/auth errors.
Restore in production-like clusters requires careful static pod and data-dir handling.
verificationChecklist: Snapshot save command succeeds.
I can explain restore prerequisites and risks.

title: Helm Release and Kustomize Overlay Basics
objective: Perform basic Helm and Kustomize operations.
objectiveMm: Helm နှင့် Kustomize ၏ အခြေခံ လုပ်ဆောင်ချက်များကို လေ့ကျင့်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: A test namespace and internet access for chart repos (or pre-downloaded charts).
steps: Add a chart repo, install a release, then list releases.
Upgrade the release with changed values and verify rollout/resources.
Create/apply a simple Kustomize overlay that changes replicas or labels.

yamlManifests.name: kustomization.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- deployment.yaml
namePrefix: demo-

expectedOutput: Helm release installed/upgraded successfully; Kustomize renders/applies modified manifests.
troubleshooting: Chart values/schema differ by chart version; inspect with `helm show values`.
Kustomize paths must be correct relative to kustomization.yaml.
verificationChecklist: I can manage a Helm release lifecycle.
I can preview and apply a Kustomize overlay.

title: CRD and Extension Interface Discovery
objective: Discover CRDs and identify CNI/CSI/CRI-related components.
objectiveMm: CRDs များနှင့် CNI/CSI/CRI ဆိုင်ရာ components များကို ရှာဖွေဖော်ထုတ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Any Kubernetes cluster (some CRDs may already exist).
steps: List CRDs and describe one CRD schema/resource.
List API resources and find custom resources if present.
Inspect kube-system and relevant namespaces for CNI/CSI/runtime-related pods.
expectedOutput: CRDs/API resources and extension-related components are identified.
troubleshooting: Not all clusters expose the same component names; focus on roles/interfaces.
verificationChecklist: I can inspect CRDs/custom resources.
I can identify extension interface components in a cluster.

title: Deployment Rollout and Rollback
objective: Create, scale, update, and rollback a Deployment.
objectiveMm: Deployment ကို create/scale/update/rollback လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Test namespace.
steps: Create a Deployment with nginx image.
Scale replicas and verify Pods.
Update image to trigger rollout, then rollback to previous revision.

yamlManifests.name: web-deploy.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80

expectedOutput: Deployment scales and rolls out/rolls back successfully.
troubleshooting: If rollout stuck, check `kubectl describe deployment/web` and pod events.
Image tag typos cause ImagePullBackOff.
verificationChecklist: Replicas scaled correctly.
Rollback restored previous revision.

title: Jobs and CronJobs Practice
objective: Create and inspect Job and CronJob workloads.
objectiveMm: Job နှင့် CronJob workloads များကို ဖန်တီးစစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Any cluster with batch/v1 support.
steps: Create a one-off Job and wait for completion.
Create a CronJob with a short schedule in a lab environment.
Inspect created Jobs/Pods and logs.

yamlManifests.name: cronjob.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: hello
spec:
  schedule: "*/5 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
          - name: hello
            image: busybox:1.36
            command: ["sh", "-c", "date; echo hello"]

commands: kubectl create job once --image=busybox:1.36 -- sh -c 'echo done'
expectedOutput: Job completes; CronJob creates Jobs on schedule.
troubleshooting: CronJob timing depends on controller manager and cluster time.
Check pod logs for command output.
verificationChecklist: Job completed successfully.
CronJob generated at least one Job (or configuration validated).

title: ConfigMap, Secret, Probe, and Resources
objective: Configure an app Pod with external config, probe, and resource settings.
objectiveMm: ConfigMap/Secret, probe နှင့် resources များဖြင့် Pod ကို ပြင်ဆင်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Test namespace.
steps: Create ConfigMap and Secret.
Deploy a Pod/Deployment consuming them via env/envFrom or volumes.
Add readiness probe and resource requests/limits; verify Pod status.

yamlManifests.name: config-probe.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  APP_MODE: demo
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-secret
type: Opaque
stringData:
  PASSWORD: example
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app-config-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: nginx:1.27
    envFrom:
    - configMapRef:
        name: app-config
    env:
    - name: PASSWORD
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: app-secret
          key: PASSWORD
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 50m
        memory: 64Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 200m
        memory: 128Mi
    readinessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 80
      initialDelaySeconds: 3
      periodSeconds: 5

expectedOutput: Pod becomes Ready; env vars from ConfigMap/Secret available.
troubleshooting: Probe failures keep Pod NotReady; check container port/path.
Secret key names must match exactly.
verificationChecklist: Config and secret injected correctly.
Probe and resources visible in Pod spec/status.

title: Taints, Tolerations, and Node Affinity
objective: Control Pod placement with scheduling primitives.
objectiveMm: Scheduling primitives များဖြင့် Pod placement ကို ထိန်းချုပ်ခြင်း။
prerequisites: Cluster with at least one schedulable node
environmentSetup: Use labels/taints on a test node; clean up after lab.
steps: Label a node and create a Pod with node affinity/selector.
Apply a taint to the node and observe scheduling behavior.
Add a matching toleration and confirm Pod can schedule.

yamlManifests.name: toleration-pod.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: tolerate-pod
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "dedicated"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "lab"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27

expectedOutput: Pod scheduling behavior changes according to taints/tolerations/affinity rules.
troubleshooting: Pending pods: inspect Events for FailedScheduling reasons.
Remove test taints/labels after practice.
verificationChecklist: I can apply/remove taints and labels.
I can explain why a Pod is Pending due to scheduling constraints.

title: HPA and Self-Healing Observation
objective: Create an HPA and observe controller self-healing behavior.
objectiveMm: HPA ဖန်တီးခြင်းနှင့် self-healing behavior ကို လေ့လာခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Deployment with CPU requests set.
steps: Create a Deployment with resource requests.
Create an HPA targeting the Deployment.
Delete a Pod and observe automatic recreation by the controller.

yamlManifests.name: hpa-demo.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-hpa-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-hpa-demo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-hpa-demo
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: web-hpa-demo
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: web-hpa-demo
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 4
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50

expectedOutput: HPA object created; deleted pod replaced by Deployment controller.
troubleshooting: HPA may show unknown metrics if metrics-server is missing.
Self-healing still works via Deployment even without HPA scaling events.
verificationChecklist: HPA created and inspectable.
Pod recreation observed after deletion.

title: Service Types and Endpoints
objective: Expose a Deployment and verify service endpoints.
objectiveMm: Deployment ကို expose လုပ်ပြီး service endpoints များကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Cluster with working Pod networking.
steps: Deploy an app with labels.
Create ClusterIP/NodePort services and inspect endpoints/endpointslices.
Test connectivity from within the cluster.

yamlManifests.name: svc-demo.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: echo
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: echo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: echo
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: echo-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: echo
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80

expectedOutput: Service has endpoints matching pod IPs; in-cluster request succeeds.
troubleshooting: Empty endpoints usually mean selector/label mismatch.
Port/targetPort mismatch breaks connectivity.
verificationChecklist: Service resolves to backing pods.
Connectivity test succeeds.

title: NetworkPolicy Allow/Deny Behavior
objective: Apply a NetworkPolicy and validate traffic restrictions.
objectiveMm: NetworkPolicy ကို အသုံးပြုပြီး traffic restrictions များကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Namespace with test client/server pods.
steps: Deploy server and client pods with labels.
Confirm baseline connectivity.
Apply restrictive NetworkPolicy and retest connectivity.
Add allow rule and verify permitted traffic.

yamlManifests.name: netpol-demo.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-allow-web
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: web
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80

expectedOutput: Traffic allowed/blocked according to policy (if enforced by CNI).
troubleshooting: If policy has no effect, CNI may not enforce NetworkPolicy.
Namespace selectors require correct labels on namespaces.
verificationChecklist: Policy selects intended pods.
Observed behavior matches policy intent.

title: Ingress and Gateway API Resource Inspection
objective: Create/inspect Ingress and review Gateway API resources.
objectiveMm: Ingress ကို ဖန်တီး/စစ်ဆေးခြင်းနှင့် Gateway API resources များကို လေ့လာခြင်း။
prerequisites: Gateway API CRDs/controller for Gateway tests (optional)
environmentSetup: Cluster with routing components if testing live traffic; otherwise practice manifests and inspection.
steps: Create Service-backed app and an Ingress resource.
Inspect IngressClass/Ingress status and rules.
List Gateway API resources if installed and compare object roles.

yamlManifests.name: ingress-demo.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: web-ingress
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
  - host: web.example.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: echo-svc
            port:
              number: 80

expectedOutput: Ingress resource created; routing works when a matching controller exists.
troubleshooting: Ingress without controller/class will not route traffic.
Gateway API objects require installed CRDs and controller implementation.
verificationChecklist: I can author a basic Ingress manifest.
I can identify Gateway API resource types and purpose.

title: CoreDNS Health and DNS Resolution Test
objective: Verify CoreDNS operation and test in-cluster DNS.
objectiveMm: CoreDNS လုပ်ဆောင်ချက်နှင့် in-cluster DNS resolution ကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Cluster with CoreDNS deployed (default in most distributions).
steps: Check CoreDNS pods and kube-dns Service/endpoints.
Inspect CoreDNS logs and ConfigMap.
Run DNS lookup tests from a temporary pod.
commands: kubectl get cm coredns -n kube-system -o yaml
expectedOutput: CoreDNS healthy and service names resolve to cluster IPs.
troubleshooting: If lookups fail, verify CoreDNS pods, endpoints, and network policies affecting DNS.
Check node/pod networking and upstream config in Corefile.
verificationChecklist: CoreDNS components are healthy.
In-cluster DNS lookups succeed.

title: CNI and Service Networking Inspection
objective: Identify networking components and trace service-to-pod mapping.
objectiveMm: Networking components များကို ဖော်ထုတ်ပြီး service-to-pod mapping ကို ခြေရာခံခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Any running cluster.
steps: Identify CNI and kube-proxy/dataplane pods in kube-system.
Inspect node PodCIDRs and service resources.
Map a Service selector to Pod IPs/endpoints.
expectedOutput: Clear view of CNI components, pod CIDRs, and service endpoint mapping.
troubleshooting: Component names vary by CNI implementation; focus on function.
verificationChecklist: I can locate networking components.
I can explain how a Service selects backend Pods.

title: PVC Mount in a Pod
objective: Create and mount a PVC for persistent data.
objectiveMm: Persistent data အတွက် PVC ကို ဖန်တီး mount လုပ်ခြင်း။
prerequisites: Cluster with default StorageClass or pre-created PV
environmentSetup: Namespace with storage support.
steps: Create a PVC and wait for binding (if dynamic provisioning available).
Create a Pod mounting the PVC and write test data.
Restart/recreate Pod and verify data persistence (depending on backend).

yamlManifests.name: pvc-pod.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: data-pvc
spec:
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pvc-demo
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data
      mountPath: /data
  volumes:
  - name: data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: data-pvc

expectedOutput: PVC binds and mounted volume is writable/readable in Pod.
troubleshooting: Pending PVC: check StorageClass, provisioner, events, and access mode compatibility.
Pod Pending: check volume attachment/mount events.
verificationChecklist: PVC bound successfully.
Pod can read/write mounted data.

title: StorageClass and Provisioning Behavior
objective: Inspect StorageClasses and understand dynamic provisioning settings.
objectiveMm: StorageClasses နှင့် dynamic provisioning settings များကို စစ်ဆေးနားလည်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Cluster with at least one StorageClass (most local clusters provide one).
steps: List StorageClasses and identify default class.
Describe provisioner, reclaimPolicy, and volumeBindingMode.
Create a PVC using a specific StorageClass and observe binding behavior.
expectedOutput: StorageClass properties understood; PVC binding behavior observed.
troubleshooting: WaitForFirstConsumer delays binding until a Pod uses the PVC.
verificationChecklist: I can identify default StorageClass.
I can explain reclaimPolicy and access modes.

title: Diagnose PVC/PV and Mount Issues
objective: Use events and describe output to troubleshoot storage problems.
objectiveMm: Storage ပြဿနာများကို events/describe output များဖြင့် troubleshoot လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Use an intentionally misconfigured PVC/Pod in a lab namespace.
steps: Create a PVC requesting unavailable class/size/mode (lab scenario).
Observe Pending state and inspect events/describe output.
Correct the manifest and verify successful binding/mount.
expectedOutput: Root cause identified from events and resolved by configuration fix.
troubleshooting: Common causes: missing StorageClass, no matching PV, access mode mismatch, node affinity constraints.
verificationChecklist: I can identify why PVC/Pod is Pending.
I can validate fix through status/events.

title: Node Troubleshooting Workflow
objective: Practice systematic node triage using kubectl and node-level checks.
objectiveMm: Node ပြဿနာများကို စနစ်တကျ triage လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Lab cluster where a node issue can be simulated or reviewed.
steps: Check node statuses and conditions.
Inspect events and workloads affected by node issues.
Review kubelet/service indicators and propose remediation steps.
expectedOutput: Likely failure domain identified (kubelet, runtime, network, pressure, etc.).
troubleshooting: Distinguish control-plane vs worker symptoms.
Drain/cordon considerations depend on workload state.
verificationChecklist: I can gather evidence for node issues.
I can propose/execute safe remediation steps.

title: Pod and Control Plane Symptom Debugging
objective: Debug common Pod failures and inspect control plane component health.
objectiveMm: Pod failures နှင့် control plane component health များကို debug လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Namespace with sample broken manifests (image typo, bad command, bad config).
steps: Deploy a broken Pod/Deployment and identify failure reason.
Use describe, logs, previous logs, and events to pinpoint root cause.
Fix manifest and verify recovery; inspect kube-system control plane pods for health signals.

yamlManifests.name: broken-pod.yaml
yamlManifests.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
